title: Leaders from QTS, Everspin among winners of Governor’s Celebration of Innovation awards
summary: Phoenix Business Journal highlights Everspin CEO Sanjeev Aggarwal’s recognition at Arizona’s Governor’s Celebration of Innovation for technology leadership.
body_markdown:
By


[Greg Barr](https://www.bizjournals.com/phoenix/bio/40179/Greg+Barr) – Editor in Chief, Phoenix Business Journal


Phoenix Business Journal highlights Everspin Technologies President and CEO Sanjeev Aggarwal among the leaders recognized at the 2026 Governor’s Celebration of Innovation, which honors technology, business and innovation across Arizona.


Sanjeev received the MSS Business Transformation Leader of the Year award, recognizing his leadership at Everspin and the company’s role in Arizona’s semiconductor and technology ecosystem.


[Read the full article in Phoenix Business Journal](https://www.bizjournals.com/phoenix/news/2026/11/18/tech-council-governors-awards-innovation.html)
